STEP 1 - Scene: A salad plate with mixed leafy greens (looks like frisée/mizuna-type curly leaves with small seeds or quinoa-like grains and a light dressing), cherry tomatoes, and a slice of baked savory tart or pizza-like square with cheese, peppers and a bit of meat or sausage crumble.

STEP 2 - Vessel: A white square plate, roughly 24 cm across. Area ≈ 24 × 24 × ~0.85 (rounded corners) ≈ 490 cm². Use ~480 cm².

STEP 3 - Items: mixed curly greens with dressing/seeds; cherry tomatoes (2 visible); savory tart slice (crust, cheese, pepper, meat bits); a few shreds of onion/carrot.

STEP 4 - Area (share of vessel):
- Mixed greens: ~35% (168 cm²)
- Tart slice: ~8% (38 cm²)
- Cherry tomatoes: ~3% (14 cm²)
- Minor items (onion, carrot, dark bits): ~2% (10 cm²)
Total covered ≈ 48%, consistent with the photo.

STEP 5 - Volume (height × area):
- Greens: 168 cm² × 3 cm ≈ 504 ml
- Tart: 38 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 76 ml
- Tomatoes: 14 cm² × 2 cm ≈ 28 ml
- Minor: 10 cm² × 1 cm ≈ 10 ml

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Greens: 504 × 0.15 ≈ 76 g
- Tart: 76 × 0.95 ≈ 72 g
- Tomatoes: 28 × 0.6 ≈ 17 g
- Minor: 10 × 0.6 ≈ 6 g
Total ≈ 171 g.

STEP 7 - Energy:
- Greens with dressing: 76 g × 35 kcal/100 g ≈ 27 kcal (dressing included)
- Tart: 72 g × 260 kcal/100 g ≈ 187 kcal
- Tomatoes: 17 g × 18 kcal/100 g ≈ 3 kcal
- Minor: 6 g × 40 kcal/100 g ≈ 2 kcal
Total ≈ 219 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: A partly covered square plate with one tart slice and a leafy salad, about 170 g and roughly 220 kcal, is plausible.
